name: Glyph

description.project: A terminal-first snippet manager for saving, organizing, searching, and reusing shell commands and small code fragments.
description.technical: Command-line application written in Go. Uses Cobra for command routing, SQLite for local persistence, and Bubble Tea with Lip Gloss to provide an interactive terminal interface.

features.name: Snippet library
features.description: Users can create, edit, delete, and search saved command snippets from the terminal.
features.implementation: Implemented SQLite-backed create, read, update, and delete operations. Added stable snippet identifiers and text search across snippet names, commands, and descriptions.

features.name: Interactive browser
features.description: Provides a keyboard-driven interface for browsing snippets and previewing their contents.
features.implementation: Built a Bubble Tea model with explicit selection and navigation states. Used Lip Gloss styles to keep list rows, detail previews, and status messages consistent across terminal views.

features.name: Shell output and copy
features.description: Lets users print a snippet for piping into another command or copy it for reuse.
features.implementation: Added dedicated output commands that write snippet contents to standard output without UI formatting, allowing snippets to participate in shell pipelines. Interactive mode offers a separate copy action.

highlights: Built a local snippet store with SQLite-backed CRUD operations and text search.
Created a keyboard-driven terminal interface using Bubble Tea.
Designed plain-output commands that support shell pipelines.
